text:
Maya: Quick sync - we need final copy for the booth poster + webinar landing page by EOD Thu. Angle: 'Real LLM inference at scale - latency & cost tradeoffs'. Keep primer-friendly.

Jon: +1. Also want a short benchmark narrative (3 bullets) comparing hosted vs dedicated perf/cost for the handout.

Sam: I can draft the 3 bullets. Shipping update: 300 stickers, 150 tees inbound (UPS tracking 1Z9999XYZ).

ops-bot: UPS 1Z9999XYZ scanned - arrival at local hub 03/16.

Maya: Inbound routing plan: QR on booth -> tiny form (email + company) -> Zapier -> Salesforce queue 'conference-spring-2026' + slack notify #sales-inbound. Sam, can you paste the webhook snippet?

Sam: sure - example payload: `POST /api/leads HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{ "email":"{{email}}", "source":"spring-demo", "utm":"meetup-booth" }`

Jon: Messaging iteration: Poster A = "Ship production-grade inference - predictable latency." Poster B = "Lower per-token cost, same quality." We'll A/B test which CTA drives more signups.

Sasha: Speaker submission status: abstract submitted this morning, program chair reviewing. Deadline for accepted speakers: 03/18. I pinged them.

Maya: Webinar tie-in: host a 30-min benchmark deep-dive 2 weeks after event. Landing slug: `benchmarks.redwood.ai/spring-demo`. Route webinar signups to nurture track `post-event-bench`.

Jon: Logistics checklist: booth schedule, volunteer roster, swag manifest, power strip + 2 adapters, table runner, two laptops for live demos. Need one more volunteer Thu afternoon. @lisa - you free?

Lisa: I can cover Thu 1-4pm.

Sam: Swag packing list for courier: 150 tees (mixed S-XL), 300 stickers, 100 postcards, 2 promo chargers, table runner. I'll assemble packing manifest.

Maya: I'll book courier pickup Fri 09:00 from Office A. ops-bot, please confirm pickup once scheduled.

ops-bot: Courier pickup requested for 03/17 09:00 - tracking will be posted after label generation.

Sam: I'll drop the launch post copy in #marketing-drafts in ~1h for copy iteration + social snippets (X, LinkedIn). Need short benchmark stat for hero card.

Jon: tiny ask - make sure QR redirects include `?utm_source=booth&utm_campaign=spring-demo`. Also add `utm_content` for poster variant A/B.

Sam: confirmed - tracking params added to QR shortlink.

Maya: Action list: Sam = bench bullets + swag manifest + launch post draft; Jon = poster A/B comps; Sasha = follow up program chair; Lisa = booth volunteer Thu 1-4; Maya = courier + webinar calendar. Everyone react with :white_check_mark: when done.

Jon: One more - can demos highlight both Hosted API latency and Dedicated predictability? Short 2-slide demo, ok?

Maya: Yes, 2-slide demo works. Keep it <90s per demo. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
